title: These Popular Kids’ Halloween Costumes Are Over 60% Off This October Prime Day, From ‘Wicked’ to ‘Descendants’

The lineup of kids’ Halloween costumes includes outfits inspired by hit musicals like  Wicked  and Disney’s  Descendants , plus Hogwarts uniforms,  Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu , Bumblebee from Transformers and even a Benjamin Franklin costume. Whether your kid wants to dress like a favorite character or surprise everyone with a more unexpected pick, these markdowns make Halloween shopping a little easier on the wallet.

Just remember, the wig is sold separately — also marked down 20% — so you’ll need to add one for the full transformation.
